descr: I was with another friend who is wearing this glasses in my class. When we sit and started to wait for lecture to begin, we realized our lecturer was avoiding eye contact with us but it was obvious that he was bit curious. Then, he asked about it and my friend made him a joke saying that it is a camera etc. Then, we told the truth and it was funny.
descr_english: During our break, the lecturer approached me and asked if I was recording her because she felt nervous about it. I felt sorry and thought I could let my lecturers know about the glasses.
future_use_english: It won't affect my future use, but I can inform people about it beforehand.
